title: PAIN OUT: Improvement in Postoperative PAIN OUTcome
summary: PAIN OUT is a multi-national, non-interventional registry and benchmark project, assessing and analysing clinical and patient-reported outcome data of postoperative pain.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>= 18 years or \>= 4 years for sub-project QUIPSI/PAIN OUTinfant
* patient is post-op day 1
* patient is at least 6 hours on the ward
* patient has given consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient cannot communicate
* patient is cognitively impaired
* patient is asleep
* patient is too ill
* patient does not want to fill in the questionnaire
